svg.title: Foundry Pricing: Learn, Then Commit
svg.desc: Foundry Tools pricing progression: start on pay-as-you-go during pilots and variable use, then move a feature with steady volume to a commitment tier; token-based model workloads use provisioned throughput instead.
svg.text: Pay as you go while usage is unknown; commit once it's steady.
